item.title: Learning Portfolio
item.description:
Learning Portfolio

This portfolio documents my learning journey during the PhD at PPGIT/Unifesp: reflections, learnings and connections with my research for each seminar of the Seminários I course (2025). The seminar reflections themselves are written in Portuguese — links below lead to the Portuguese pages.

Seminars I — 2025

April 2025

  • [02/04] Non-nutritional technologies in sports and wellness - Arthur Gáspari
  • [09/04] Innovation for accessibility - Marcio Horta
  • [16/04] Developing an Edtech - João Pedro Molina
  • [23/04] Post-development and degrowth - Bárbara Bastos
  • [30/04] Racist Algorithms: Borders between Technology and Innovation - Adriana Marques

May 2025

  • [07/05] Transcranial neuromodulation: is this the psychiatry of the future? - Marcelo de Oliveira Fonseca
  • [14/05] Digital Accessibility - Tiago Silva da Silva
  • [28/05] Life Cycle Assessment - Guilherme Nogueira

June 2025

  • [04/06] World Environment Day - Marina Dias
  • [11/06] An overview of gender inequalities in the Brazilian labor market - Daniela Verzola Vaz

Critical Reflections

Each seminar brought valuable insights and different perspectives on themes relevant to my research. Through this portfolio I document not only the presented content, but also my personal reflections and how each theme connects with my doctoral work on sociotechnical co-creation with family farmers.
